arxiv-2002-12812.title: Optical Incoherence Tomography: a method to generate tomographic retinal cross-sections with non-interferometric imaging systems
arxiv-2002-12812.description: Abstract Optical tomographic cross-sectional images of biological samples were made possible by interferometric imaging techniques such as Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Owing to its unprecedented view of the sample, OCT has become a gold standard, namely for human retinal imaging in the clinical environment.

arxiv-2201-08199.title: Surreal fields stable under exponential and logarithmic functions
arxiv-2201-08199.creator: Olivier Bournez olivier.bournez@lix.polytechnique.fr, Quentin Guilmant quentin.guilmant@lix.polytechnique.fr
arxiv-2201-08199.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Olivier Bournez olivier.bournez@lix.polytechnique.fr, Quentin Guilmant quentin.guilmant@lix.polytechnique.fr. Surreal numbers, that were initiated by Conway and popularized by Knuth, have a very rich and elegant theory, rooted in strong fundamental nice set theoretic foundations. This class of numbers, denoted by No , includes simultaneously the ordinal numbers and the real numbers, and forms a universal huge real closed field: It is universal in the sense that any real closed field can be embedded in it.

arxiv-2202-08912.title: Mechanical response to tension and torque of molecular chains via statistically interacting particles associated with extension, contraction, twist, and supercoiling
arxiv-2202-08912.creator: Aaron C. Meyer, Michael Karbach, Ping Lu, Gerhard Müller
arxiv-2202-08912.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aaron C. Meyer, Michael Karbach, Ping Lu, Gerhard Müller. A methodology for the statistical mechanical analysis of polymeric chains under tension introduced previously is extended to include torque. The response of individual bonds between monomers or of entire groups of monomers to a combination of tension and torque involves, in the framework of this method of analysis, the (thermal or mechanical) activation of a specific mix of statistically interacting particles carrying quanta of extension or contraction and quanta of twist or supercoiling.

arxiv-2206-08848.title: Optimal tests of genuine multipartite nonlocality
arxiv-2206-08848.creator: Mahasweta Pandit, Artur Barasiński, István Márton, Tamás Vértesi, Wiesław Laskowski
arxiv-2206-08848.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Mahasweta Pandit, Artur Barasiński, István Márton, Tamás Vértesi, Wiesław Laskowski. We propose an optimal numerical test for genuine multipartite nonlocality based on linear programming. In particular, we consider two non-equivalent models of local hidden variables, namely the Svetlichny and the no-signaling bilocal model.

We consider the low-energy effective action of string theory at order α ′ \alpha^{\prime} , including R 2 R^{2} -corrections to the Einstein-Hilbert gravitational action and non-trivial dilaton coupling.

pmc-11322655.title: SARS-CoV-2 N protein-induced Dicer, XPO5, SRSF3, and hnRNPA3 downregulation causes pneumonia
pmc-11322655.creator: Yu-Wei Luo, Jiang-Peng Zhou, Hongyu Ji, Doudou Xu, Anqi Zheng, Xin Wang, Zhizheng Dai, Zhicheng Luo, Fang Cao, Xing-Yue Wang, Yunfang Bai, Di Chen, Yueming Chen, Qi Wang, Yaying Yang, Xinghai Zhang, Sandra Chiu, Xiaozhong Peng, Ai-Long Huang, Kai-Fu Tang
pmc-11322655.description: Though RNAi and RNA-splicing machineries are involved in regulating severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) replication, their precise roles in coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pathogenesis remain unclear. Herein, we show that decreased RNAi component (Dicer and XPO5) and splicing factor (SRSF3 and hnRNPA3) expression correlate with increased COVID-19 severity.

pmc-11431610.title: Anti-Biofouling Polyzwitterion–Poly(amidoxime) Composite Hydrogel for Highly Enhanced Uranium Extraction from Seawater
pmc-11431610.creator: Lang Yang, Ye Sun, Yue Sun, Jiawen Wang, Lin Chen, Xueliang Feng, Jinggang Wang, Ning Wang, Dong Zhang, Chunxin Ma
pmc-11431610.description: Amidoxime-functionalized hydrogels are one of most promising adsorbents for high-efficiency uranium (U) extraction from seawater, but bioadhesion on their surface seriously decreases their adsorption efficiency and largely shortens their service life. Herein, a semi-interpenetrating zwitterion–poly(amidoxime) (ZW-PAO) hydrogel was explored through introducing a PAO polymer into a poly [3-(dimethyl 4-vinylbenzyl amino) propyl sulfonate] (PDVBAP) polyzwitterionic (PZW) network via ultraviolet (UV) polymerization.

pmc-12604804.title: Progress and stagnation: A comparative study of gender representation in Chinese language textbooks for junior high school between 2001 edition and 2023 edition
pmc-12604804.creator: Xia Yang, Yu Sun, Hu He, Rafael Galvão de Almeida, Rafael Galvão de Almeida, Rafael Galvão de Almeida, Rafael Galvão de Almeida, Rafael Galvão de Almeida
pmc-12604804.description: Gender bias in textbooks is a global problem. Gender development stands as a pivotal concern among junior high school students, underscoring the paramount importance of scrutinizing gender portrayals within textbooks. Chinese language textbooks, utilized by around 200 million students, have garnered scant attention in English literature concerning its embedded gender ideology.

pmc-12747099.title: Robot‐Assisted Laparoscopic Partial Nephrectomy for Mixed Epithelial and Stromal Tumor of Kidney: A Case Report
pmc-12747099.creator: Sachie Kaichi, Hotaka Matsui, Sayuri Takahashi, Kazuki Akiyama, Daiji Watanabe, Satoru Taguchi, Yuta Yamada, Daisuke Yamada, Mariko Tanaka, Haruki Kume
pmc-12747099.description: Mixed epithelial and stromal tumor (MEST) of the kidney is a rare and distinctive neoplasm accounting for 0.2% of all renal tumors. The general treatment for MEST typically involves radical nephrectomy or partial nephrectomy. We report a rare case of MEST successfully treated with robot‐assisted partial nephrectomy (RAPN), which, to our knowledge, represents the first documented instance of this approach.

pmc-12986951.title: A Fiber- and Plant-Based Nutraceutical Attenuates Insulin Resistance and Oxidative Stress in Type 2 Diabetic Mice
pmc-12986951.creator: Shing-Hwa Liu, Ting-Yu Chang, Meng-Tsan Chiang
pmc-12986951.description: Background/Objectives: Nutraceuticals, consisting of bioactive compounds or materials, are increasingly regarded as promising strategies for the prevention and management of diabetes. This study aimed to evaluate the antidiabetic potential of a nutraceutical formulation (Sugar Care, SC) composed of indigestible maltodextrin, pumpkin extract, and bitter melon extract, using a type 2 diabetic mouse model.

pmc-13260609.title: Processing of different word list lengths during encoding and retrieval in Broca’s area
pmc-13260609.creator: Viktors Veliks, Aleksandrs Kolesovs, Juris Porozovs, Dmitrijs Igonins
pmc-13260609.description: Broca’s area is a region of the brain involved in the processing of verbal information, including memory encoding and retrieval. This study examined differences in the neural correlates of encoding and retrieval in Broca’s area using word lists of varying lengths.
